models_evaluated: 14 commercial and open-source models (incl. localized open-source models)

links.outcome: Safety-relevant IDDSI texture classification of deployed MLLM pipeline on clinician-verified meal image benchmark
links.effect: Qwen-based pipeline exact match accuracy 61.74%, lowest total false negative rate of 9.2% among 14 models; local open-source models had 100% FNR for liquids versus 7.14% for the cloud system.
links.quote: Our Qwen-based pipeline achieved a total exact match accuracy of 61.74%.

unlisted_practices: Bi-directional safety logic and chain-of-thought cascaded pipeline to minimize false negatives for choking hazards
Physical rheological testing by certified clinical specialists as ground truth for image-based texture auditing

screen.reason: Evaluates a multimodal LLM-driven IoT platform using a newly established 115-meal benchmark dataset to assess dietary texture auditing for dysphagia safety across 14 models, focusing on model/pipeline accuracy and hazard miss rates.
